name: week
title: This week
subtitle: Case Management for Claude Code: what needs a decision and who is booked, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Needs a decision
sections.note: Worst first. An unreported mandatory concern outranks everything.
sections.sql: select reason as why, label as record, client, place as who_where, days, detail from v_attention order by rank, days desc nulls last

sections.title: Booked in the next seven days
sections.sql: select ref, to_char(session_on, 'Dy DD Mon') as day, client, worker, mode, program from v_sessions where attendance = 'booked' and session_on between current_date and current_date + 7 order by session_on, worker

sections.title: The waitlist
sections.note: Longest wait first. Every week on the list is a family without a service.
sections.sql: select ref as file, client, program, days_waiting, referred_by, case when consent then 'yes' else 'NO' end as consent from v_waitlist order by days_waiting desc

sections.title: The team
sections.note: Safety check and supervision state loud. EXPIRED means no sessions.
sections.sql: select name, role, check_state as safety_check, to_char(safety_check_expires_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as expires, supervision_state as supervision, open_files || '/' || caseload_cap as caseload, booked_next_7d from v_team where status = 'active' order by name

name: funders
title: Funders and outcomes
subtitle: Delivery against each funding agreement, the Data Exchange and outcome scores, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Delivery against target, period to date
sections.note: Compare the share delivered with the share of the period gone.
sections.sql: select code, name as programme, funder, clients_served || '/' || coalesce(target_clients::text, '-') as clients, sessions_delivered || '/' || coalesce(target_sessions::text, '-') as sessions, elapsed_pct || '%' as time_gone, waitlist, to_char(report_due_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as report_due from v_programs order by code

sections.title: Data Exchange: not yet reported
sections.note: LATE means the reporting period has closed with these sessions missing.
sections.sql: select to_char(dex_period_end, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as period_ends, to_char(dex_due_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as closes, count(*) as sessions, case when bool_or(state = 'DEX LATE') then 'LATE' else 'open' end as state from v_sessions where dex and attendance = 'attended' and dex_reported_on is null group by dex_period_end, dex_due_on order by dex_period_end

sections.title: Outcome scores, first to last
sections.note: SCORE pairs per programme and domain.
sections.sql: select program, domain, count(*) as pairs, round(avg(pre_score), 2) as avg_pre, round(avg(post_score), 2) as avg_post, round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where change > 0) / count(*)) || '%' as improved from v_outcomes group by program, domain order by program, domain
